Description:
Defines the actor roles available in the system (ADMIN, TRAINING_MANAGER, ENTERPRISE, STUDENT). Roles drive authorization across every feature.
- Primary keys: role_name
- Foreign keys: (none)

Catalog of fine-grained permission strings granted to roles (e.g. WEEKLY_REPORT_SUBMIT, GRADE_FINALIZE).
- Primary keys: permission_name
- Foreign keys: (none)

Many-to-many junction between roles and permissions. A role is granted any number of permissions and a permission may belong to multiple roles.
- Primary keys: role_name; permission_name
- Foreign keys: role_name -> roles.role_name; permission_name -> permissions.permission_name

Master account record. Holds credentials, profile basics, lockout state, and soft-delete flag. enterprise_id is set only when the user has the ENTERPRISE role.
- Primary keys: user_id
- Foreign keys: enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id (optional, set when role is ENTERPRISE)

Assigns each user to exactly one role (BR-06 single-role policy).
- Primary keys: user_id
- Foreign keys: user_id -> users.user_id; role_name -> roles.role_name

JWT identifier (jti) blacklist. Once a token is invalidated here it cannot be reused even if not yet expired.
- Primary keys: token_id
- Foreign keys: (none - recipient identity is implicit in the JWT, not stored)

One-time tokens issued for the forgot password flow. Token value is stored as a hash; is_used flips to TRUE after consumption.
- Primary keys: token_id
- Foreign keys: user_id -> users.user_id

Immutable, append-only audit trail. Captures who performed which action against which entity, with before/after payloads and request metadata.
- Primary keys: log_id
- Foreign keys: user_id -> users.user_id (nullable - some system actions have no actor)

Tracks the currently active session per email to enforce single-device login (BR-02). Stale sessions are upserted on each successful authentication.
- Primary keys: token_id
- Foreign keys: email -> users.email

Captures every HTTP request hitting the API for observability - method, endpoint, status, response time, and identity context.
- Primary keys: id
- Foreign keys: user_id -> users.user_id (nullable - anonymous traffic)

One-to-one extension of users containing student-only data: CV, academic info, social links, and demographic fields.
- Primary keys: profile_id
- Foreign keys: user_id -> users.user_id (unique)

Master record for each academic semester/term. Drives weekly report deadlines, final report deadlines, and lifecycle transitions (DRAFT -> OPEN -> ACTIVE -> CLOSED -> LOCKED).
- Primary keys: semester_id
- Foreign keys: created_by -> users.user_id

Roster of students authorised to participate in the internship program for the current semester. Status drives whether the student is ELIGIBLE, APPROVED, DEFERRED, CANCELLED, etc.
- Primary keys: eligible_id
- Foreign keys: semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; user_id -> users.user_id (nullable until student registers); cancelled_by -> users.user_id; deferred_by -> users.user_id

Append-only audit log of every status transition on an eligible student (for compliance and rollbacks).
- Primary keys: history_id
- Foreign keys: eligible_id -> eligible_students.eligible_id; changed_by -> users.user_id

Broadcasts (system messages, policy updates, banner notices). Can be scoped to the whole system, a semester, or a specific role.
- Primary keys: announcement_id
- Foreign keys: semester_id -> semesters.semester_id (nullable); created_by -> users.user_id

Many-to-many between semesters and enterprises with per-semester participation status (PENDING -> APPROVED/REJECTED).
- Primary keys: semester_enterprise_id
- Foreign keys: semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; reviewed_by -> users.user_id

Company profile: contact, tax code, industry, size, and approval state. PENDING companies cannot post jobs or accept interns until approved by a Training Manager.
- Primary keys: enterprise_id
- Foreign keys: approved_by -> users.user_id

Internship job listings created by enterprises. status (OPEN/CLOSED) controls visibility; original_max_positions snapshots quota at creation time for analytics.
- Primary keys: job_post_id
- Foreign keys: enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; created_by -> users.user_id

Student applications to a specific job_post. Carries the CV file (PDF), screening decision, and withdraw chain (withdrawn_by_application_id allows historical reference to the predecessor row).
- Primary keys: application_id
- Foreign keys: job_post_id -> job_posts.job_post_id; student_id -> users.user_id; screened_by -> users.user_id; withdrawn_by_application_id -> applications.application_id (self-ref, nullable)

Final placement decisions (the match between a student and an enterprise for a semester). Replaces previous placement when a swap occurs (self-referential replaces_application_id).
- Primary keys: application_id
- Foreign keys: student_id -> users.user_id; enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; reviewed_by -> users.user_id; created_by -> users.user_id; updated_by -> users.user_id; replaces_application_id -> placement_applications.application_id (self-ref, nullable)

Scheduled interviews between enterprises and candidates. Carries schedule, location/link, result, and back-dating metadata for late entries.
- Primary keys: interview_id
- Foreign keys: application_id -> applications.application_id; decided_by -> users.user_id; backdated_by -> users.user_id

The central hub of the internship domain. Each row is a student-enterprise pair for a specific semester. Trigger 022 enforces one ACTIVE assignment per student. replaced_by_assignment_id chains swap assignments.
- Primary keys: assignment_id
- Foreign keys: enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; student_id -> users.user_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; assigned_by -> users.user_id; replaced_by_assignment_id -> enterprise_assignments.assignment_id (self-ref, nullable)

Per-enterprise, per-semester internship plan describing the overall goal and high-level structure. Each plan is one-to-many with internship_plan_items (weekly tasks).
- Primary keys: plan_id
- Foreign keys: enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; job_post_id -> job_posts.job_post_id (optional link to originating listing); approved_by -> users.user_id; last_reviewed_by -> users.user_id

Immutable audit trail of every state change on a plan (SUBMIT, APPROVE, REJECT, REQUEST_REVISION) with actor role and free-form note.
- Primary keys: revision_id
- Foreign keys: plan_id -> internship_plans.plan_id; actor_id -> users.user_id

Weekly tasks inside a plan (week_number, task_description, target_date, status). Status is updated as the supervisor marks weekly progress.
- Primary keys: plan_item_id
- Foreign keys: plan_id -> internship_plans.plan_id

Enterprise-side evaluation of a student at the end of the assignment. total_score is GENERATED from the four component scores (attitude*0.2 + professionalism*0.4 + soft*0.2 + progress*0.2). Locks after submission.
- Primary keys: evaluation_id
- Foreign keys: assignment_id -> enterprise_assignments.assignment_id (unique - one-per-assignment)

Per-week report submitted by the student for a given assignment. Fields cover tasks completed, challenges, lessons, next-week plan, attachments, hours logged, and plagiarism/anomaly scoring.
- Primary keys: report_id
- Foreign keys: assignment_id -> enterprise_assignments.assignment_id; late_override_by -> users.user_id

Reviewer (supervisor/TM) feedback attached to a weekly report. Multiple rows per report possible (one per review action). action encodes APPROVE / REJECT / REQUEST_REVISION.
- Primary keys: feedback_id
- Foreign keys: report_id -> weekly_reports.report_id; reviewer_id -> users.user_id

End-of-internship PDF report submitted once per assignment. is_late is set when submitted after the semester deadline.
- Primary keys: final_report_id
- Foreign keys: assignment_id -> enterprise_assignments.assignment_id (unique)

Incident reports raised against an assignment (e.g. misconduct, policy violation). Carries evidence URLs, resolution status, and resolution note (mandatory once RESOLVED).
- Primary keys: incident_id
- Foreign keys: assignment_id -> enterprise_assignments.assignment_id; reported_by -> users.user_id; resolved_by -> users.user_id

Formal warnings issued by a Training Manager to a student within a specific week. Triggered only when a student has missed a weekly report submission.
- Primary keys: warning_id
- Foreign keys: tm_id -> users.user_id; student_id -> users.user_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id

Final grade for a student per semester, locked by default once issued. enterprise_total_score is captured separately from the composite final_grade for transparency; overall_status drives pass/fail.
- Primary keys: grade_id
- Foreign keys: student_id -> users.user_id (unique with semester_id); tm_id -> users.user_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id; cancelled_by -> users.user_id

Cross-cutting in-app notification feed. reference_entity + reference_id can point at any business entity (weekly_report, final_grade, interview, etc.) so clients can deep-link.
- Primary keys: notification_id
- Foreign keys: recipient_id -> users.user_id; reference_id -> varies (polymorphic, see reference_entity)

End-of-internship feedback the student submits about the enterprise (only students in semester 7-9, once per student-enterprise-semester tuple). Captures four 1-to-5 rating dimensions plus free-form comments.
- Primary keys: feedback_id
- Foreign keys: student_id -> users.user_id (unique with enterprise_id, semester_id); enterprise_id -> enterprises.enterprise_id; semester_id -> semesters.semester_id
